title: iammojogo's Dynamic Lighting
description: My own dynamic lighting mod that uses the real light render api
body:
iammojogo's Dynamic Lights Mod

This mod is meant to bring the dynamic lighting into vanilla mc. Other mods exist, and I believe even optifine might use some kind of dlighting also, but this is meant to be small, easy, yet fully function (updates needed) with using the internal lightrender class api (or whichever api forge class needed for updating). 

🔧 COMPATIBILITY

Works with JEI, JourneyMap, Xaero's Minimap, Optifine, and most client-side mods.

Requirements:

Minecraft 1.21.11 Forge 61+ Client-side only (no server installation needed)
